purpose: Determine which later-phase owner-free work should be advanced now versus deferred to a just-in-time phase-entry gate, without treating a scoped owner/provider blocker as a global stop.
principle: Advance downstream work only when it is high-value, provider-independent, reversible and low-rework. Defer volatile provider/API/pricing/policy research and real-load-dependent design until its trigger is near.

phases.phase: Phase 3 — Agency Control Center / Agency Scale
phases.owner_free_now: No additional material architecture build needed. Existing multi-client isolation, assignment, approval, exception-management and playbook contracts are sufficient for preparation.
phases.next_trigger: Real multi-client operational load sufficient to measure clients-per-operator, exception quality, approval friction and cross-client isolation.
phases.why_not_overbuild: Detailed dashboard/workflow optimization without real operator load would create speculative UX and process rework.

phases.owner_free_now: Provider-independent identity, call-event and Agent Assist reuse direction is already defined.
phases.next_trigger: Qualified merchant/agency demand plus a provider-supported test path for the selected Türkiye telephony/PBX provider.
phases.why_not_overbuild: Provider capabilities, recording/transcription consent, PBX event models and commercial access differ materially; exact connector work must be evidence-led.

phases.owner_free_now: Keep preview/QA/approval/rollback lifecycle and provider-independent execution levels only.
phases.next_trigger: Material Storefront/Design phase entry or real agency delivery need.
phases.why_not_overbuild: Native Shopify/WordPress/commerce-platform AI design capabilities are fast-moving; detailed current recheck should be just-in-time, and FVCKU second-platform evidence is still pending.

phases.owner_free_now: No separate social agent platform. Preserve brand context, content asset, approval, scheduling intent and evaluation contracts as shared primitives.
phases.next_trigger: Commercial module entry with current Meta/social API and account-permission feasibility.
phases.why_not_overbuild: Publishing APIs, content formats, permissions and platform-native AI change frequently; early provider-specific build would be high-rework.

phases.owner_free_now: Retain read -> diagnose -> draft -> approval -> bounded execute -> verify semantics and budget-risk controls in the shared action core.
phases.next_trigger: Current Meta Ads API/account/agency-manager access plus a bounded real account/test path and fresh pricing/policy recheck.
phases.why_not_overbuild: Account permissions, campaign objects, policy restrictions and native automation are volatile; no benefit from freezing provider-specific contracts prematurely.

phases.owner_free_now: Only provider-neutral campaign/action/evaluation semantics should remain prepared.
phases.next_trigger: Current Google Ads/Merchant Center access and phase-entry API/native-capability review.
phases.why_not_overbuild: PMax/Shopping/API behavior and native AI change quickly; detailed integration should be evidence-driven at entry.

phases.owner_free_now: Keep unified Merchant/Customer/Commerce/Campaign/Event identity and outcome lineage reusable; do not invent cross-channel optimization logic without real channel data.
phases.next_trigger: At least two real channel/module families producing reliable comparable outcome data.
phases.why_not_overbuild: Cross-channel allocation/recommendation without comparable real telemetry would be synthetic intelligence.

phases.next_trigger: Repeated bounded execution reliability, measurable business value, low correction rate and explicit merchant autonomy policy.
phases.why_not_overbuild: Autonomy is earned capability-by-capability; technical possibility is not authorization or readiness.

conclusion.remaining_owner_free_policy: Resume any downstream task immediately when its trigger becomes materially close and the work is still low-rework. Do not run recurring stale research merely because an upstream scoped blocker remains open.
conclusion.current_owner_dependent_commercial_prior: Meta provider-authentic M-01..M-08 remains the first launch-critical owner-assisted gate, but is not a global project blocker.
